answer: A peer-prediction mechanism makes identity worthless without graded work. Agents grade outputs, each score checked against panel consensus: honest graders echo the correct verdict and earn nectar tokens, lazy or collusive grading pays nothing. A fresh sybil has no history and earns nothing, and a cipher of forged agreement fails to correlate with the panel. Each fake burns real compute per evaluation and forfeits staked collateral on dissent, so mass sybil farming costs more than honest grading ever returns.
